description: This PHP class 'CandidateDao' serves as a Data Access Object for handling database operations related to candidates, candidate histories, interviews, and related entities within an HR recruitment system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting candidate data, as well as querying associated entities based on various filters.

classes.name: CandidateDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for managing candidate-related database operations in the recruitment module.

methods.name: getCandidatesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of candidates based on the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for candidates based on search filters, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getCandidatesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of candidates matching the search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateById
methods.description: Fetches a candidate entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getExistingCandidateIds
methods.description: Returns a list of candidate IDs that exist in the database from a provided list.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves the vacancy linkage for a specified candidate.

methods.name: saveCandidate
methods.description: Persists a candidate entity to the database.

methods.name: saveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Persists a candidate vacancy linkage to the database.

methods.name: deleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes candidates identified by the given list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Deletes the vacancy linkage for a given candidate.

methods.name: saveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Persists a candidate history record.

methods.name: getInterviewCountByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Counts how many times a candidate has been scheduled for an interview for a specific vacancy.

methods.name: saveCandidateInterview
methods.description: Persists an interview entity related to a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all candidate IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all interview IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateIdListForHiringManger
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewById
methods.description: Fetches an interview entity by its ID.

methods.name: getCandidateListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves candidate IDs assigned to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getInterviewListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves interview IDs assigned to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: isInterviewer
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number is an interviewer with scheduled interviews.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecords
methods.description: Fetches candidate history records based on search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordsCount
methods.description: Counts candidate history records matching filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for candidate history data based on filters.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryRecordByCandidateIdAndHistoryId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific candidate history record by candidate and history IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewByCandidateIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Fetches an interview record for a given candidate and interview IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewIdsByCandidateId
methods.description: Returns a list of interview IDs associated with a candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdList
methods.description: Retrieves all candidate history record IDs.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Retrieves history record IDs for candidates linked to a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves history record IDs for candidates assigned to a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns vacancy IDs associated with candidates for a specific interviewer.

methods.name: getCurrentVacancyIdByCandidateId
methods.description: Fetches the current vacancy ID linked to a specific candidate.

methods.name: getCandidateHistoryByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
methods.description: Retrieves candidate history records for a given candidate and vacancy combination.
